verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is an iOS terminal and SSH/Mosh client that ships a set of local commands, so bundling git tooling is a plausible axis for it. However, its documented local commands (cat, grep, ls, cp and similar) include nothing for git or history rewriting. Running git rebase on a remote host over SSH is a workaround, not a Blink capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can interactively rewrite history by deleting, editing, squashing, or reordering commits
